content: Vedant Thakur called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to cancel his auto insurance policy (#AV-45231) because he sold his car. Neha explained the cancellation process, noting an effective cancellation date of today, a $20 cancellation fee, and a prorated refund of approximately $450 to be issued to his card on file. Vedant agreed to proceed, and Neha confirmed the policy status would update to expired and an email confirmation with a refund receipt would be sent.

action_items: Issue prorated refund of approximately $450 to the card on file
Send email confirmation and refund receipt to the customer
